description: Only for the Awning team. How the website is doing over the last days. people: visitors in browsers from Umami — totals against the previous period, top pages, sources, channels, countries, devices, and events such as lead_form_started / lead_form_field / lead_form_submitted (how far people get with the business form). all_visits: every page served, counted on our server and split into people, assistants and crawlers — assistants do not run scripts, so only this part shows them. When summarising, compare with the previous period and name the share of assistants.
name: op_analytics
title: Site analytics
